chunks: Ziyad ibn Suqah narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
"There is no issue with one of you performing salat (prayer) in a single garment while its buttons are undone. Indeed, the religion of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله is upright."

key_terms.حَنِيفٌ: upright, inclining to truth and free of undue hardship
key_terms.دِينِ مُحَمَّدٍ: the religion of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem or prohibition

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) in a single garment with its buttons undone?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that it is permissible to perform salat (prayer) in a single garment even if its buttons are undone. It also emphasizes the ease and upright nature of the religion of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.
